environment.description: Service deployed behind CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef8.cloudfront.net) with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy type 'sigv4' for custom origin. Origin is configured with custom header x-origin-verify set to a 256-bit rotating secret managed by Secrets Manager with automatic rotation every 4 hours. The origin ALB listener rule requires header x-origin-verify to match current secret value, returning 403 for all requests without valid header. CloudFront distribution has a Behavior configured with Viewer Protocol Policy: HTTPS Only, and a CloudFront Function at viewer-request stage that validates CloudFront signed URLs using Trusted Key Group (kg-9f8e7d6c) — requests without valid Policy+Signature+Key-Pair-Id query parameters receive 403 before reaching origin. The signed URL policy restricts DateLessThan to 300 seconds from issuance and IpAddress to the requester's /32 CIDR. Note: the format_dynamic function's %s replacement is a string interpolation pattern, not a C-style format string vulnerability — Rust's type system prevents memory corruption from format strings.
